global.description: Global daemon options: logging, PID file, interface, and PTP domain to monitor.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Use '-' to log to stdout.

pid_file.description: Full path to PID file used for daemon control.

interface.description: Network interface to monitor (e.g., 'eth0'). Leave empty to monitor all PTP-capable interfaces.

domain_number.description: PTP domain number to monitor. -1 means all domains; typical values are 0 (default) or 127 (custom domain).

alarm.description: Time error alarm thresholds and behavior (values in nanoseconds).

enabled.description: Enable time error monitoring and alarm triggers.

warn_threshold.description: Absolute time error (in ns) that triggers a warning alarm.

warn_threshold_rms.description: Root mean square (RMS) time error (in ns) over recent samples to trigger warning.

error_threshold.description: Absolute time error (in ns) that triggers a critical alarm.

error_threshold_rms.description: RMS time error (in ns) above which a critical alarm triggers.

hold_time.description: Duration (in seconds) an alarm must persist before escalation (e.g., triggering notification).

notifications.description: Notification configuration for alarm events and status updates.

ready_notify.description: If true, notify systemd of daemon readiness (requires systemd).

handlers.description: List of external notification endpoints to alert on alarms.

endpoint.description: URL for HTTP or facility:priority for syslog (e.g., 'local0.info').

retries.description: Number of retry attempts on failure.

health.description: Internal health monitoring settings for the daemon itself.

enabled.description: Enable health monitoring of the ptpmon process and data freshness.

timeout.description: Seconds without fresh sync data before marking the daemon unhealthy.

sinks.description: Optional external PTP sink endpoints to verify sync quality from the local device’s perspective.

enabled.description: If true, monitor external PTP sinks in addition to local domain.

endpoints.description: List of host:port strings for external PTP sinks.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the PTP sink.
